title: Shared definitions
description:
Values that more than one schema needs, in one place.

Codex, chunk 0 round 6: these lived inside incident.schema.json and were referenced from the other files by absolute id. Every ref resolved in production, because the validator registers all schemas together — but it made two formerly independent files silently depend on the incident schema, and an absolute $ref is only a name: nothing fetches the file it points at.

The schemas are a package, not four separate documents. Nothing here compiles alone, and a test checks that every cross-file reference points at a schema the validator actually registers.

evidenceSource.description: Where a fact came from. One carrier: this list also governs what a chat answer may cite, and the two drifting apart would let a message cite a source no evidence can have.

severity.description: One carrier for how bad something is, shared by an incoming alert and by an agent's finding.
